## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Build or dependency change

## Verification

- [ ] `mvn -B -DskipTests package` passes
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] API documentation is updated
- [ ] No secrets or local absolute paths are included

## Database and Configuration Impact

Describe schema, profile, environment variable, or deployment changes.

## Screenshots or Logs

Add evidence for user-facing or runtime changes when applicable. Remove credentials and personal data.
